executableEdges.reason: The scheduled trigger (daily) runs one program, retention.ts's purgeOriginals, through `runRetention`; HTTP requests go through the Effect web handler and need no runner.

hostTooling.reason: Host programs on the operator's machine: the CLI (do.ts), local D1 migration, the cf token preflight, hook and compiler installers.
The respondent's page: DOM, canvas, media decoding and fetches against the Worker's /api. It is not Effect code and never runs on the Worker; it only imports the pure shared modules.
The vite-plus config runs in the build host; it reads process.env.VITEST only to skip the Cloudflare plugin for plain unit tests.

allowedAdapters.reason: The fetch and scheduled edges hand each request (or the daily retention run) to one Effect program and copy its response into a native Response. No business logic lives here beyond routing.

aiProviderTransports.reason: Every model call goes through the Workers AI binding (env.AI.run / toMarkdown), wrapped as one Effect per call with strict decoding of the answer.
